Pot and effective stack are computed from the action-line bet sizes in the bundled path, plus folded-blind dead money (SB 0.5bb, BB 1.0bb when that blind folded).

TexasSolver v0.2.0 console_solver has no rake setting. Configured spots are rake-free. A standard-rake variant is not expressible in that CLI; this report does not mark those cells UNCOMPARABLE, because the v1 draft already queued them as rake-free. The limitation is recorded here.
T0 is the existing 72-spot v1 draft (6 pot families x 12 flops at 100bb), not a slice of the 16-class grid.
T1 is all 16 matchups at 100bb x the first 8 texture classes. T2 is 40bb and 200bb x those same 8 classes. T3 is the remaining 8 classes across all 16 matchups and 3 depths.

texture_class_definitions.trips-board: Three cards of the same rank.
texture_class_definitions.paired high: Exactly one pair, pair rank ten or higher.
texture_class_definitions.paired low: Exactly one pair, pair rank nine or lower.
texture_class_definitions.monotone high: Unpaired, not trips, all three suits equal, high card ten or higher.
texture_class_definitions.monotone low: Unpaired, not trips, all three suits equal, high card nine or lower.
texture_class_definitions.A-low wet: Unpaired, not monotone, ace-high, both side cards seven or lower, and either a flush draw (two-tone) or strongly connected (including the ace-to-five wheel).
texture_class_definitions.A-high dry: Unpaired rainbow ace-high, second card nine or lower, not strongly connected.
texture_class_definitions.K-high dry: Unpaired rainbow king-high, not strongly connected.
texture_class_definitions.Q/J-high dry: Unpaired rainbow queen- or jack-high, not strongly connected.
texture_class_definitions.mid dry: Unpaired rainbow, high card ten, nine, or eight, not strongly connected.
texture_class_definitions.low dry: Unpaired rainbow, high card seven or lower, not strongly connected.
texture_class_definitions.two-tone A/K high: Unpaired two-tone, ace- or king-high, and not an A-low wet board.
texture_class_definitions.two-tone broadway: Unpaired two-tone, at least two broadway cards (ten or higher), high card queen or lower (so ace/king-high two-tone boards stay in two-tone A/K high).
texture_class_definitions.two-tone connected mid: Unpaired two-tone, strongly connected, high card eight through jack.
texture_class_definitions.rainbow connected mid: Unpaired rainbow, strongly connected, high card eight through jack.
texture_class_definitions.rainbow connected low: Unpaired rainbow, strongly connected, high card seven or lower.
texture_class_definitions.strongly_connected: Three distinct ranks whose span is at most 4 (they fit in a five-card straight window), or the ace-low wheel equivalent.
